Switch Installation Connection
Saga Telecom switches support a variety of mounting methods. ● Network Cable
Please install according to the actual environmental requirements.
● Desktop Use Cat5 and above network cable, shielded type is recommended.
● Wall mounted ● Grounding
Ensure that the grounding screw of the device is effectively grounded
for safe use.
● Optical Fiber
1. Optical fibers must be used with the fiber modules.
2. Fiber bending radius must not be less than 40mm.
● Power Cord
1. Distance between power cable and network cable should be more
than 10cm.
2. The AC power please use the local standard.
Commercial Managed Switch
Safety Precautions
User Manual
● Do not look directly at the optical port to prevent the laser
beam from burning your eyes.
● Do not install the power cord with power on to avoid personal
(Please do not use until you read this manual)
injury.
● Do not supply power before device installation and wiring.
● Do not install the device in the environment of seepage, drip or
condensation easily, otherwise the equipment might burn out .
● Please ensure the environment where the device is installed is
well ventilated, and forbidden to block the cooling holes.
● Do not install the device in a high density dust environment.
● Do not use aerial cabling outdoor, otherwise the device is
prone to lightning strike.
● ESD protection is necessary during installation or maintenance
● Grounding and wire routing help limit the effects of noise due
to electromagnetic interference(EMI).
● Do not place heavy objects on the device.
● Rack mounted ● Please use this device in the given range of temperature and
1. Install 4 floating screws on the front hole bar of the cabinet, humidity.
2 on each side. ● If rack switches are in a natural heat dissipation environment,
2. Load the device into the cabinet. please ensure the separation distance exceeds 1U.
3. Use M6 screws to secure the device with the cabinet/rack. ● Installation, commissioning and maintenance may only be
4. Install earth wire to earth connection point. performed by qualified electricians.
